purpose: Teach: エディション/マウント/薄型/最速/ユーザビリティ/ポテンシャル/ゼネコン/ウエイト

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、論文の改訂エディションを準備しろ
lines.en: Ren — prepare a revised edition of the paper.
lines.style: Direct and measured. Brief pause after the name. Expectant but not harsh. The tone of someone accustomed to being obeyed, issuing instruction like a standing order.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。先輩研究員にマウントを取らない姿勢で接します
lines.en: Yes. I'll approach the senior researchers with respect, not looking to compete.
lines.style: Quick uptake, earnest commitment. Slight breathiness—eager to show understanding and alignment. No hesitation. The voice of someone trying to prove readiness.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、薄型実験装置を活用しろ
lines.en: Ren — make use of the slim-profile equipment.
lines.style: Same measured command. Slight emphasis on the instruction itself. No elaboration. The efficiency of someone who assumes understanding and compliance.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。最速で論文を投稿します
lines.en: Yes. I'll submit the paper as soon as possible.
lines.style: Quick acknowledgment. Slight strain of ambition underneath—showing he's understood not just the instruction but the urgency. Crisp, forward-leaning delivery.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、実験装置のユーザビリティを評価しろ
lines.en: Ren — evaluate the usability of the equipment.
lines.style: Steady instruction, same register. A slight expansion of scope. Delivered without inflection, as if adding one more piece to a longer list he's already laid out.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。自身のポテンシャルを信じて挑みます
lines.en: Yes. I'll trust in my own potential and take it on.
lines.style: Respectful but with a thread of quiet resolve underneath. Not showing off—just acknowledging he's heard the weight of what's being asked. Steady exhale on the closing phrase.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、ゼネコン系企業との産学連携も視野
lines.en: Ren — also keep industry partnerships with construction firms in your sights.
lines.style: Broadest directive yet. Delivered with the same composure but a hint of strategic weight. Opening slightly slower, expecting this to land as a larger piece. Not a suggestion.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。研究テーマのウエイト配分を整理します
lines.en: Yes. I'll organize the balance of my research priorities.
lines.style: Final affirmation. Slight deepening of tone—he's absorbed the scale of what's ahead. Not breathless now, but grounded. A closing note of sincere commitment, letting the sentence trail naturally.
